high_level_description: stc brand style, a cinematic living room scene of three men from a television production, one playing a lute.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A room with gray and white polka dot wallpaper, a wooden shelf displaying books and a framed motorcycle artwork, warm cozy lighting, TV visible at the bottom of the frame.

elements.desc: A man wearing a mint green long-sleeved shirt, gesturing animatedly, on the left.
A man wearing a white traditional thobe and glasses, sitting relaxed, in the middle.
A man wearing a brown plaid shirt, holding a tan-colored lute, on the right.
A brown football on the dark coffee table in front of them.
